parsed.content: The system records the details of the voucher sales transaction between the MISU sales team and the distributor.
The system allocates specific vouchers (with their numbers and batch numbers) from the available stock to the distributor based on the quantity required.
The system generates an auto-generated Distribution Invoice Number for the transaction.
The system updates the inventory by marking the distributed vouchers as sold and associating them with the specific distributor and salesman.
The system calculates the invoice amount based on the number of vouchers sold and the wholesale price.
